insights.one_liner: Swiss packaging-systems maker for cartons, pouches and bag-in-box, founded in 1853; its Tilburg entry-level finance job requires Dutch.

culture.text: Makes packaging systems for food, and says it is the only supplier covering carton, pouch and bag-in-box.
Headquartered in Neuhausen, Switzerland, and listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange.
